taglineZh: 逐条核对语义、焦点、表单、热区、读屏与动效的无障碍要求
taglineEn: Rule-by-rule checks for semantics, focus, forms, hit areas, screen readers and motion
descZh: 按主题核对界面的可访问性：语义与 ARIA、焦点与键盘、表单、触控热区、对比度、读屏、动效与缩放，共 52 份细则。审一份界面对键盘和读屏是否友好，或写代码前把无障碍要求列全时用。产出分项规则与检查清单，不负责组装整页。
descEn: Audits interface accessibility topic by topic: semantics and ARIA, focus and keyboard, forms, touch hit areas, contrast, screen readers, motion and zoom, across 52 reference rules. Use it to review how keyboard- and screen-reader-friendly a UI is, or to list requirements before coding. Outputs itemized rules and checklists, not full pages.
demoCaptionZh: 设置页无障碍审查清单示例，逐项标注通过、待修与对比度证据
demoCaptionEn: Sample accessibility audit checklist for a settings page with pass/fix verdicts and contrast evidence

taglineZh: 列全聊天界面的状态：流式、审批、排队、分支与错误恢复
taglineEn: Every chat UI state: streaming, approval, queueing, branches and error recovery
descZh: 规定 AI 对话界面要处理哪些状态、每个状态长什么样：消息全生命周期、工具调用与人工审批、输入排队、分支切换、错误恢复与减少动效。评审或设计聊天式产品、发现界面只画了理想路径时用。产出状态清单、每种状态的界面要求与验收项。
descEn: Defines which states an AI chat interface must handle and how each looks: full message lifecycle, tool calls with human approval, composer queueing, branch switching, error recovery and reduced motion. Use it when reviewing or designing chat products that only cover the happy path. Outputs a state inventory, per-state UI requirements and acceptance items.
outputZh: 状态清单与逐状态验收项
outputEn: State inventory and per-state acceptance checklist
demoCaptionZh: 聊天界面三个关键状态小样：流式输出、工具审批卡与断连错误恢复
demoCaptionEn: Three key chat UI states: streaming output, a tool approval card and disconnect recovery

taglineZh: 动手前先定视觉方向：拆参考图，并排比较几种路线
taglineEn: Set the visual direction first: dissect references, compare routes side by side
descZh: 给界面先定艺术方向：拆解参考图的背景、卡片、文案动作与视觉语气，产出方向描述与可落地的视觉要素清单。产品要有性格、不要模板感，或动手前需要并排比较几种视觉路线时用。共 28 份参考，给判断与规则，不组装整页。
descEn: Sets an interface's art direction before building: dissects reference imagery into background, cards, copy actions and visual tone, then outputs a direction statement plus an actionable visual-element list. Use it when a product needs personality instead of template feel, or to compare visual routes side by side. 28 references; gives judgment and rules, not assembled pages.
outputZh: 方向描述与视觉要素清单
demoCaptionZh: 同一笔记产品的两种艺术方向小样：暖纸编辑风与暗夜仪表风
demoCaptionEn: Two art directions for the same notes product: warm paper editorial vs dark instrument panel

taglineZh: 驱动浏览器实测网站，提取可机读的完整 Brand Kit
taglineEn: Measure a live site in-browser and extract a complete machine-readable brand kit
descZh: 用内置浏览器实测线上网站的 DOM 与 CSS，提取 Logo、七个语义角色的色板、字体与实际字重、文案语气和大幅图片，逐步写入 brand.json 并实时预览 brand.html。要从参考站建立品牌或设计系统时用。每个值都必须来自页面实测，不凭印象生成；遇反爬墙停下来请用户处理。
descEn: Drives an in-app browser to measure a live site's DOM and CSS, extracting logos, a seven-role semantic palette, fonts with used weights, voice and large imagery, writing brand.json progressively with live brand.html previews. Use it to build a brand or design system from a reference site. Every value must trace to measurement, never guesswork; anti-bot walls pause for the user.
outputZh: brand.json 与可预览的品牌指南页
outputEn: brand.json plus a previewable brand-kit page
demoCaptionZh: 虚构咖啡品牌网站的实测提取报告：语义色、字体字重、Logo 与语气
demoCaptionEn: Measured extraction report for a fictional roastery site: semantic colors, fonts, logo and voice

taglineZh: 把 Anthropic 官方品牌色与字体应用到交付物
taglineEn: Apply Anthropic's official brand colors and typography to artifacts
descZh: 把 Anthropic 官方品牌色与字体应用到页面、文档等交付物，保持统一的视觉识别，也可作为制定自家品牌规范的参照。收录自 Anthropic 官方 skills 仓库，完整素材与脚本在上游包中。需要 Anthropic 风格视觉或想参考一份成熟品牌规范时用。
descEn: Applies Anthropic's official brand colors and typography to pages, documents and other artifacts for a consistent visual identity, and serves as a reference for shaping your own guidelines. Curated from Anthropic's official skills repository; full assets and scripts live in the upstream bundle. Use it for Anthropic-styled visuals or as a mature brand-specimen reference.
outputZh: 符合官方品牌规范的页面与文档
outputEn: Artifacts styled to the official brand guidelines
demoCaptionZh: Anthropic 品牌色卡与字体应用示例：暖纸底、陶土色按钮与衬线标题
demoCaptionEn: Anthropic brand swatches and type application: warm paper, terracotta button, serif headline

taglineZh: 策略先行的高端品牌指南板：网格分区、克制排版、电影感
taglineEn: Strategy-first premium brand boards: gridded panels, sparse type, cinematic mood
descZh: 生成高端品牌指南板图像：深炭底、网格分区、稀疏排版与克制的视觉密度，先推断品牌策略与符号隐喻再落视觉。覆盖开发者工具、安全、奢侈品、游戏等类别的标识系统、色板、字体与应用小样。要一张能直接放进提案的品牌世界总览图时用。
descEn: Generates premium brand-guideline board images: dark charcoal canvas, gridded panels, sparse typography and restrained density, inferring brand strategy and symbol metaphor before visuals. Covers logo systems, palettes, type and application mockups for developer tools, security, luxury, gaming and more. Use it for one presentation-ready overview image of a whole brand world.
outputZh: 品牌指南板图像（默认 3×3 网格）
outputEn: Brand-guideline board image (3×3 grid by default)
demoCaptionZh: 虚构开发者工具 Vantage 的 3×3 品牌板：标识构造、色板、字体与 UI 应用
demoCaptionEn: A 3×3 brand board for fictional dev tool Vantage: mark construction, palette, type and UI application

taglineZh: 84 家网站的具体设计 token：色值、字阶、圆角、间距
taglineEn: Concrete design tokens from 84 sites: colors, type scale, radii, spacing
descZh: 84 家网站设计语言的查询库，给可直接写进 CSS 的具体值而不是形容词。要定落地页色板字阶、复刻某产品的视觉气质或给项目写 DESIGN.md 时，打开对应品牌的文件读 frontmatter token。硬规矩：不许凭记忆写品牌色值，结论必须给出文件路径。
descEn: A lookup library of 84 sites' design languages, giving values you can paste into CSS instead of adjectives. When setting a landing page's palette and type scale, echoing a product's visual character, or writing a DESIGN.md, open the brand's file and read its frontmatter tokens. Hard rule: never write brand values from memory; cite the file path.
outputZh: 可直接写进 CSS 的设计 token
demoCaptionZh: 虚构项目 Nimbus 的 DESIGN.md token 卡片：色板、字阶、圆角与间距，点击复制
demoCaptionEn: DESIGN.md token cards for fictional project Nimbus: colors, type scale, radii and spacing, click to copy

taglineZh: 把改好看点拆成可点名、可执行的逐维整改指令
taglineEn: Turn make-it-prettier into nameable, executable per-dimension fix instructions
descZh: 用一套可点名的设计词汇给界面下准确指令，按间距、配色、字体、动效、层级逐维整改，共 51 份细则。已有界面看着平、要提升质感，或要把模糊的改好看点拆成可执行动作时用。产出整改清单与可直接交给编码助手的具体指令。
descEn: Uses a nameable design vocabulary to give precise UI instructions, fixing interfaces dimension by dimension across spacing, color, type, motion and hierarchy, with 51 reference rules. Use it when an existing UI looks flat and needs polish, or to break a vague make-it-prettier into executable actions. Outputs a fix list of concrete instructions ready for a coding assistant.
outputZh: 整改清单与具体编码指令
outputEn: Fix list with concrete coding instructions
demoCaptionZh: 同一张产品卡片的整改前后对比，附可直接执行的词汇化指令清单
demoCaptionEn: Before/after of the same product card with an executable vocabulary-based instruction list

taglineZh: Emil Kowalski 的动效与细节哲学：让界面手感正确
taglineEn: Emil Kowalski's motion and detail philosophy for interfaces that feel right
descZh: 编码 Emil Kowalski 的设计工程哲学：看不见的细节累积成手感。按使用频率决定要不要动画，进出场用强缓出曲线、禁用缓入，按键触发的操作不加动画， popover 从触发点缩放。审查 UI 代码时用 Before/After/Why 表格逐条给理由。要打磨组件微交互与动效细节时用。
descEn: Encodes Emil Kowalski's design-engineering philosophy: unseen details compound into feel. Decide whether to animate by usage frequency, use strong ease-out curves for entrances, never ease-in, keep keyboard-triggered actions instant, and scale popovers from their trigger. Reviews UI code in Before/After/Why tables with reasons per row. Use it to polish component micro-interactions and motion detail.
outputZh: 带动效细节的组件与 Before/After 审查表
outputEn: Polished components and Before/After review tables
demoCaptionZh: 微交互实验台：强缓出开关、按压缩放按钮、从触发点弹出的浮层与缓动对比
demoCaptionEn: Micro-interaction bench: strong ease-out toggle, press-scale button, trigger-origin popover and easing race

taglineZh: 暖纸底低饱和油墨色板：多级灰阶与 8 组彩色阶梯
taglineEn: Warm-paper low-saturation ink palette: neutral ramp plus 8 hue ladders
descZh: 面向屏幕读写的低饱和油墨色板，色值来自 MIT 许可的 Flexoki：暖纸底 #FFFCF0、多级中性灰阶、8 组彩色阶梯，深浅双底色。给笔记应用、文档站、编辑器或代码高亮定颜色时用，彩色只作语义点缀。产出 CSS 变量、亮暗映射与语义角色分配。
descEn: A low-saturation ink palette for on-screen reading and writing, values from MIT-licensed Flexoki: warm paper #FFFCF0, a multi-step neutral ramp, 8 hue ladders, light and dark bases. Use it to color note apps, docs sites, editors or code highlighting, with chromatic hues reserved for semantics. Outputs CSS variables, light/dark mappings and semantic role assignments.
outputZh: CSS 变量、亮暗映射与语义角色
outputEn: CSS variables, light/dark mapping and semantic roles
demoCaptionZh: Flexoki 全色板：暖纸底灰阶与八组彩色阶梯，可切换亮暗主题查看语义映射
demoCaptionEn: Full Flexoki board: neutral ramp and eight hue ladders on warm paper, with a light/dark semantic toggle
